book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.en: I slept from exhaustion on the raft.

sentences.ar: لما صحيت، كانت الشمس على وجهي.
sentences.en: When I woke, the sun was on my face.

sentences.ar: ناس واقفين حولي وبيحكوا لغة ما بعرفها.
sentences.en: People were standing around me speaking a language I did not know.
I had reached an island called Serendib.

sentences.ar: جبالها عالية وفيها كل أنواع الشجر.
sentences.en: Its mountains are high and it has every kind of tree.

sentences.ar: أخذوني عند ملكهم وحكيت له كل إشي.
sentences.en: They took me to their king and I told him everything.

sentences.ar: ما صدق إني عبرت الجبل بالنهر.
sentences.en: He could not believe I had crossed the mountain by the river.
